newsitem.title: USA: Fed okays Banc One-First USA merger.
newsitem.headline: Fed okays Banc One-First USA merger.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Board said Wednesday it approved a request by Banc One Corp. to merge with First USA Inc.
The merger would give Columbus, Ohio-based Banc One ownership of Dallas-based First USA's First USA Federal Savings Bank and its nonbank subsidiaries, the Fed said.

Banc One, with $102 billion in assets, is the 10th largest commercial banking organization in the country, while First USA's assets are only about one-tenth that size at $10.2 billion. The merger would make Banc One the eight largest U.S. commercial banking organization with $112.2 billion in assets.

First USA is the country's fourth largest issuer of credit cards. Its other nonbanking activities include industrial loans, processing credit and debit card transactions for merchants, licensing software used in processing credit and debit cards and several other businesses related to credit and debit cards.

The Fed said it found no significant adverse anti-competitive affects from the merger and concluded that for Bank One to operate a savings association, nonbanking depository institutions and to extend credit and data processing services are closely related to banking.
